name: Atkins Farms
description: Atkins Farms is a independent farm in Eudora, AR. It grows Blueberries, Blackberries, Corn, Tomatoes, and Peppers, with seasonal availability through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
